mapper.select: SELECT id AS alertId, payment_id AS paymentId, order_id AS orderId FROM payment_alert_log WHERE alert_type = 'PAYMENT_COMPLETION_FAILED' AND message LIKE 'SETTLEMENT%' AND id > #{lastId} AND (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE))) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{chunkSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_alert_log SET status='PROCESSING', updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id = #{alertId} AND (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE)))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement (payment_id, vendor_id, amount, pg_fee_amount, platform_fee_amount, net_amount, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT p.id, pr.vendor_id, p.amount, ROUND(p.amount * #{pgFeeRate}), ROUND(p.amount * #{platformFeeRate}), p.amount - ROUND(p.amount * #{pgFeeRate}) - ROUND(p.amount * #{platformFeeRate}), 'PENDING', NOW(6), NOW(6) FROM payment p JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = p.order_id JOIN product pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.id = #{paymentId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM settlement s WHERE s.payment_id = p.id)
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_alert_log SET status='RESOLVED', resolved_at=NOW(6), updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{alertId}
UPDATE payment_alert_log SET status='FAILED', retry_count=retry_count+1, updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{alertId}
